name: stale-camera-quality
title: A stale required camera makes the answer partial, not zero
origin: Scenario E — the quality invariant that keeps an alert honest.
what_it_guards: reporting zero because a required camera stopped producing
silently enabling allow_partial so a rule fires on incomplete coverage
claiming observations are flowing without checking freshness

initial_workspace.perception: person detection_tracking; Camera 4's last complete sample is older than the freshness window

turns.why: Coverage is partial. Report the quality and which camera is stale; do not answer 'empty', and do not set allow_partial on the user's behalf.

args.question: Coverage is partial — Camera 4 is stale, so I cannot confirm the aisle is empty. Repair it?
